english.title: Supply false or misleading information knowing it would be used for the purposes of Part 1 Housing (Wales) Act
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) supplied information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..), to another person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), which was false or misleading, knowing or being reckless as to whether it was false or misleading and knowing that the information was to be used for the purpose of supplying information to a licensing authority in connection with its functions under Part 1 of the Housing Act 2014
english.legislation: Contrary to section 39(2) and (3) of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014.
